exercises: Put the two vowels together. Which letter do you get? ㅗ + ㅏ = ?
Put the two vowels together. Which letter do you get? ㅜ + ㅓ = ?
Choose the word that means 'ear': 기 / 구 / 귀
Choose the correct spelling of 'chair': 으자 / 이자 / 의자
Fill in the blank to say 'It's hot.': 더_요 (와 / 워 / 위)
Read the word aloud, then write it in the Roman alphabet: 화장실

letters.as: like 'wa' in 'wander' — start with rounded lips (ㅗ) and open quickly to 'a' (ㅏ)
like 'wo' in 'won' — start with rounded lips (ㅜ) and move quickly to ㅓ
like English 'we', but shorter — start with rounded lips (ㅜ) and move quickly to 'ee' (ㅣ)
no close English match — start with ㅡ (lips flat and relaxed, not rounded) and slide quickly to 'ee' (ㅣ); in this worksheet only at the start of a word, as in 의자

objective: Recognize and pronounce ㅘ (wa), ㅝ (wo), ㅟ (wi) and word-initial 의 (ui) as quick two-vowel glides, and correctly read and choose the words 과자, 사과, 화장실, 뭐, 더워요, 위, 귀, 의자 and 의사.
summary: This worksheet teaches four Korean compound vowels: ㅘ, ㅝ, ㅟ and ㅢ. Each one is two vowels said quickly one after the other, as a single smooth sound. You will see which two vowels make up each letter, link three of them to familiar English sounds, and practise reading easy everyday words such as 과자, 뭐, 귀 and 의자.
title: 이중 모음 ㅘ·ㅝ·ㅟ·ㅢ 읽기
